data.name: Dodd Roofing and Exteriors
data.address: 950 E State Hwy 114 Ste 160, Southlake, TX 76092

reviews.text: Evan and Caleb were the best!!  Very friendly and professional.  They had amazing communication throughout the whole job and were fantastic at winning my claim from an insurance denial.

This roofing company is not an honest company. They claim they are from Texas but it is an Idaho company. I asked the salesperson if they were a Texas made company and he said yes. Well, I went ahead and let them give me a roof inspection and I never heard back from them. This makes me think they are a storm chasing company like many roofing companies. It's hard to know who to trust which is why I prefer a local, TX born company. Many roofing companies come through when there is a storm, collect

These guys were great. Loved the approach. Definitely family friendly and felt no pressure. They helped so much with the claim initiation process. First time homeowner and they answered every question with integrity and in-depth explanation. Brandon and Caleb understood my situation and I felt the confidence they were going to help us. Recommend 100%.

We had significant damage from a major wind storm and Dodd roofing went above and beyond in the process with our insurance carrier. We worked directly with Brandon and Caleb and I can’t say enough good things about them. They truly have the customer’s best interest in mind And really went to work on our behalf to get the most from our insurance provider. We are extremely thankful for all that they did!

Dodd Roofing is excellent! Their team is hardworking, professional and truly values their customers. From start to finish, they’ll show up on time, communicate clearly and get the job done without cutting corners. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship really stands out. Highly recommended if you need any roofing services in your future!!!
Dodd Roofing is the best! Caleb and Brandon are a superb duo! They execute the insurance process perfectly and professionally. I recommend them to anyone I know for a high quality roof installation!

Working with Alec has been great especially in terms of communication.

With such a big project that was key for us to feel comfortable. I would definitely recommend Dodd.

Alec provided excellent customer service throughout the whole roofing process. He was responsive, friendly, and kept me updated every step of the way. A stress-free experience, and I highly recommend him!
Evan communicated so well, was always on time, talked through options with us and even came out before install to patch a section before the rain came. We are very happy!

Brandon with Dobbs has been phenomenal to work with. He is informative,kind and conscientious.  We trust him and what he says is exactly what comes to fruition. It's so nice working with an honest company.  Thank you Dobbs and especially you Brandon!!!

Couldn’t ask for a better company to fix my roof issues. Everyone at Dodd makes you feel like family. Literally didn’t have to lift a finger or deal with the headaches with my insurance, they did it all. Definitely recommend and will pass them on to all my friends and family.
Fantastic experience from start to finish! Evan was incredibly helpful, professional, and made the whole process smooth and stress-free.
Great company to work with.  Easy process great prices.  Evan was super knowledgeable and made our lives easy.
They get the job done. Evan was especially great to communicate with. Overall, it was a smooth experience.
Evan was really easy and understanding to work with, and the team overall did an excellent job
Evan is a great guy and was very helpful during the process. I would highly recommend!
Evan is so awesome to work with. He is kind, patient, and very knowledgeable!
Evan is very genuine and easy to work with. I recommend working with this company.
Loved working with this company, especially Evan! Would definitely recommend!
Evan is awesome and very easy to work with. I recommend working with this company.
Highly recommend! Alec Donn is amazing and great company
Honest straight forward quality company with a very knowledgeable  helpful team every step of the way!
Good, honest people. Alec is awesome!
Evan is great to work with and very informative!
